caseNameFull: Bowen, Secretary of Health and Human Services v. Gilliard and Kirk, Secretary, North Carolina Department of Human Resources v. Gilliard

opinions.text:
Appeals from D. C. W. D. N. C. Motion of appellees for leave to proceed in forma pauperis granted. Probable jurisdiction noted, cases consolidated, and a total of one hour allotted for oral argument.

Certiorari Granted
